module: Single facade between the UI (Vue) and the grid selectors (vehicles, gameplay, apps, freeroam, quick race, light runner, bus routes). Each call receives the backend name as its first argument and is dispatched to the matching `ui_<name>_general` extension. The module normalizes paths, tile groups, filters, display data, header and management details before returning them to the UI, and provides fallback values for optional methods missing from a backend.
usage:
local snap = ui_gridSelector.getSelectorSnapshot('vehicleSelector', {keys = {}})
for _, group in ipairs(snap.groups) do log('I', 'x', #group.tiles) end
notes: Valid backend names: vehicleSelector, gameplaySelector, appSelector, freeroamSelector, quickraceSelector, lightRunnerSelector, busRouteSelector. Any other name gives a log error and nil.
A path is normalized to { keys = {...} }: accepts { keys = {...} } or an array of segments (string, number, boolean converted to string). Anything else gives { keys = {} } with a warning.

Backend contract: required methods getTiles, getFilters, getSearchText, setSearchText, getDisplayDataOptions, setDisplayDataOption, resetDisplayDataToDefaults, getScreenHeaderTitleAndPath, getDetails. Optional methods with fallback: getManagementDetails, executeButton, executeDoubleClick, toggleFavourite, requestClusterTiles, requestDetails, clearAllFilters, closedFromUI, profilerFinish.

getActiveFilters, toggleFilter, updateRangeFilter, resetRangeFilter, resetSetFilter and exitCallback are forwarded to the backend but have NO fallback: if the backend does not define them, an error is logged and nil is returned.
The comment placed before M.toggleFavourite in the code (exploreFolder/goToMod commented out) is disabled code; exploreFolder and goToMod are actually defined further down in the file.
A tile without `key` gets a generated key `__missingTileKey_<backend>_<n>`.

BackendContract.desc: Describes the expected backend contract: `requiredMethods` (list of names) and `optionalMethods` (list of names).

dependencies.desc: Backend extensions loaded before this module (the seven `ui_*Selector_general`).

getBackendByName.desc: Returns the backend extension table associated with the given name, or nil if the name is unknown.

backendName.desc: vehicleSelector, gameplaySelector, appSelector, freeroamSelector, quickraceSelector, lightRunnerSelector or busRouteSelector

getTiles.desc: Requests the tiles from the backend for a path and returns a normalized array of groups (non-table groups and tiles ignored, shallow copy, key generated if missing).

path.desc: Path { keys = {...} } or array of segments.

....desc: Extra arguments passed to the backend.

requestClusterTiles.desc: Requests the tiles of a cluster from the backend (optional method, fallback: nil).

getActiveFilters.desc: Returns the backend's active filters (no fallback).

toggleFilter.desc: Enables or disables a filter on the backend side (no fallback).

updateRangeFilter.desc: Updates a range filter on the backend side (no fallback).

resetRangeFilter.desc: Resets a range filter on the backend side (no fallback).

resetSetFilter.desc: Resets a set-of-values filter on the backend side (no fallback).

getSearchText.desc: Returns the backend's current search text (required).

getDisplayDataOptions.desc: Returns the backend's display options (sorting, grouping, etc.) (required).

resetDisplayDataToDefaults.desc: Resets the display options to their default values (required).

getScreenHeaderTitleAndPath.desc: Returns the screen header title and path segments for the given path (required).

profilerFinish.desc: Notifies the backend that profiling has finished (optional, fallback: nil).

closedFromUI.desc: Notifies the backend that the screen was closed from the UI (optional, fallback: nil).

getDetails.desc: Returns the details of the selected item (required).

requestDetails.desc: Asks the backend to prepare an item's details (optional, fallback: nil).

executeButton.desc: Executes an action button of the details panel (optional, fallback: nil).

getManagementDetails.desc: Returns the management buttons/details (optional, fallback: { buttons = {} }).

executeDoubleClick.desc: Executes the double-click action on a tile (optional, fallback: nil).

toggleFavourite.desc: Toggles an item's favorite state (optional, fallback: false).

getSelectorSnapshotSlices.desc: Builds a payload containing only the requested slices: tiles (groups + defaultFocusKey), filters, displayData, searchText, managementDetails, header. If no slice is enabled, all of them are.

returns.desc: { backendName, path, groups?, defaultFocusKey?, filters?, displayData?, searchText?, managementDetails?, header? }.

getSelectorSnapshot.desc: Returns a full snapshot (all slices) of the selector for a path.

returns.desc: See getSelectorSnapshotSlices. The default tile (forceAutoFocus or isDefaultSelected) gives defaultFocusKey.

exploreFolder.desc: Opens a folder in the system file explorer (Engine.Platform.exploreFolder).

goToMod.desc: Navigates the UI to a mod's details page (route menu.mods.details).
